evidence: A commenter recommends uuid-utils after reporting that the separate uuid7 package used an incompatible draft format.

evidence_sources.author: btown
evidence_sources.excerpt: One of my favorite things about UUIDv7: the package https://pypi.org/project/uuid7/ does not implement compliant UUIDv7s, it's from a wholly incompatible draft format. That was not a fun debugging session. https://pypi.org/project/uuid-utils/ is what you want :)

source_story_title: UUIDv7 doesn't have the properties you think it does
